sources.entry: OneDev - All-In-One DevOps Platform. With Git Management, Issue Tracking, and CI/CD. Simple yet Powerful. (Source Code) MIT Java/Docker/K8S
OneDev | Git server with CI/CD, kanban and code search

summary.one_liner: OneDev is a self-hosted, all-in-one DevOps platform combining Git hosting, issue tracking, code review, CI/CD, package registries, and an AI assistant.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a Git server with code search that is language-aware for symbol navigation across any commit, plus regex search. Issues have customizable states, fields, transition rules, links, and a service desk that turns emails into issues. Pull requests support protection rules that require review or CI verification for given users, files, and branches, and Renovate integration for dependency update PRs. CI/CD jobs can be built in a GUI, with matrix jobs, reusable logic, and execution in containers, on bare metal, in sandbox VMs, or via Kubernetes or agents. The README also covers a Kanban board with automatic moves, time tracking, a built-in package registry, a versioned wiki, dashboards, saved queries with subscriptions, and clustering for high availability. Recent sections describe built-in AI features, dev-container workspaces for coding agents, and a CLI and skills for interacting with OneDev from AI agents.
use_cases: self-host git repositories with code review
track software issues and customer support tickets
run CI/CD pipelines in containers or Kubernetes
manage project dependency updates with Renovate
plan team work on a Kanban board
keep versioned project documentation in a wiki
how_to_run: See the installation guide referenced in the README for setup instructions
stack: OneDev Wrapper (replaces Java Service Wrapper from 16.9.0)
notable: Built-in language-aware code search and symbol navigation in any commit
CI/CD jobs created through a GUI, with matrix jobs and reusable logic
Service desk that lets customers open issues by email without accounts
Built-in AI teammates that work on issues, pull requests, and CI failures
Clustering for replication and horizontal scaling
caveats: Supported platforms are Linux and Windows on amd64/arm64 and macOS on Apple Silicon only; Intel Macs and FreeBSD are no longer supported
Development happens at code.onedev.io, and issues and pull requests should be submitted there rather than on GitHub
